_why_empty_overrides: BoingBag 3.9-1 supersedes files the base AmigaOS 3.9 recipe's own
`workbench-base` component already places (C, Classes, Devs, Fonts, L,
Libs, Prefs, S, Storage, System, Tools, Utilities, WBStartup) — but every
rule below is `subtree`, not `file`, so nothing here is a claim in the
sense the shipped-recipe collision test polices (see
comment: a Subtree destination is a merge point, not a claim). And
`Component.overrides` is checked within one recipe's own component list
package and a release recipe are not the same list, so an override
naming `workbench-base` would not resolve there. Which component's copy
of a same-named file actually survives on a real distribution tree is a
question for the engine that applies a package onto an already-built
tree, which this task does not build — that engine will get the same
measured, not-guessed treatment ART-127 got, when it exists.
name: BoingBag 3.9-1
